{{Quote|Whyren's Reserve, batch number NN182. The rarest of the rare. I could sell the ''Falcon'' and maybe-maybe-buy a case of this stuff. And here it is, compliments of the hotel! Mon Mothma's credits spend well, Chewie.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 4">[[Star Wars (2013) 4|''Star Wars'' (2013) 4]]</ref>}}
A '''hotel''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The hotel provided expensive living quarters with high end complimentary liquid refreshments such as ''[[Whyren's Reserve/Legends|Whyren's Reserve]]'' [[Corellian whiskey/Legends|Corellian whiskey]] Batch Number [[NN182]].

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] attempted to capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operatives and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in the hotel who were there for a secret meeting. During the ensuing fighting the hotel and adjacent [[Landing Platform DDF453-17]] caught fire. Solo and Chewbacca escaped in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the stormtroopers who called for backup from arriving [[Coruscant Underworld Police|Underworld Police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]].
